data.ruling: The refutation does not hold, so FUSB303BTMX stays for "Charger input limit". The only refutation came from the datasheet verifier, which flagged the "adjust time" figure as disagreeing with the datasheet. The stock and lifecycle verifier confirmed the part with no failed checks. I re-read the datasheet at its source. The disagreement is real, but it is an error in a recorded figure, not a failed requirement. The figure as stated said the datasheet gives no delay from an Rp change to the OUT1/OUT2 update. That is wrong: FUSB303B/D Rev. 3 Table 8 states tRpValueChange, "Time a Sink port shall wait before it can determine there has been a change in Rp", 10 ms minimum and 20 ms maximum. The recorded figure is corrected to that value, and P5 takes the corrected value. No requirement value gates this figure. IOBoard.md:361 and Research.md row R7 at e13f5f6 ask only that the input limit follow the source's advertisement (Default, 1.5 A, 3 A) so that a source offering less than 3 A is not overloaded. No Answer or Decision row (V137 to V153) sets an adjust time. The verifier also marked the corrected figure passes=true. Its comparison with the 60 ms tSinkAdj of the USB Type-C specification is a figure from outside the tree. That figure is not read here and is not a gate. Every gated value re-read in the datasheet holds. In GPIO mode, OUT1 and OUT2 encode Sink Default, 1.5 A and 3 A. They are open-drain outputs. The part supports dead-battery operation. VDD is 2.85 to 5.5 V, and TA is -40 to +85 degC. So the part fails no requirement of this function, and no part-level ground (lifecycle, end-of-life, allowlist or LCSC identity) is raised by either verifier. Scope is function because the disagreement concerns this function's recorded timing figure.
data.evidence: FUSB303B/D Rev. 3 (footer 'September, 2024 - Rev. 3'), Table 8 TIMING PARAMETERS (TA -40 to +85 degC): tRpValueChange 'Time a Sink port shall wait before it can determine there has been a change in Rp' min 10, max 20 ms. The same table gives tPDDebounce 10/15/20 ms and tCCDebounce TCCDEB +/-33 %. So the stated tPD and tCC figures are right, and 'no Rp-change delay stated' is wrong. Table 1 (pin descriptions): ID Hi-Z with OUT1 Hi-Z and OUT2 Hi-Z is 'Sink with Default Current'; OUT1 LOW with OUT2 Hi-Z is 'Sink with 1.5 A Current'; OUT1 LOW with OUT2 LOW is 'Sink with 3 A Current'. The sink thresholds are vRd-def 0.61 to 0.70 V, vRd-1.5A 1.16 to 1.31 V and vRd-3.0A 2.04 to 2.18 V. Requirement: IOBoard.md:361, 'Charger input limit | follows the USB-C source's current advertisement ... default USB current ..., 1.5 A or 3 A, so a source offering less than 3 A is not overloaded. A charger that reads it, or a CC detector that sets the limit'. It states no timing value. The stock and lifecycle verifier's checks were all agrees=true and passes=true, with failed [] (JLCPCB C895444 stock 5194, onsemi Active, Digi-Key Active 4224). selection.json keeps FUSB303BTMX at rank 1 from run T3.
